## Browse by season

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

base_dir <- "."
season_dirs <- list.dirs(base_dir, recursive = FALSE, full.names = FALSE)


season_dirs <- season_dirs[grepl("^Season\\s+\\d+$", season_dirs)]
season_dirs <- sort(season_dirs)

# Pick a thumbnail. You can swap per-season later if you want.
thumb <- "Images/Social_profile.png"

# Build cards
cards <- vapply(season_dirs, function(season) {
  path <- gsub("\\\\", "/", file.path(season, "")) # "Season 25/"
  url  <- utils::URLencode(path)

  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-lg-4">\n',
      '  <div class="card season-card">\n',
      '    <div class="season-card-media">\n',
      '      <img src="%s" class="card-img-top img-fluid" alt="%s thumbnail">\n',
      '    </div>\n',
      '    <div class="card-body">\n',
      '      <h3><a href="%s">%s</a></h3>\n',
      '      <div class="text-muted">Browse dashboards &amp; visuals</div>\n',
      '    </div>\n',
      '  </div>\n',
      '</div>\n'
    ),
    thumb, season, url, season
  )
}, character(1))

output <- paste0(
  '<div class="grid">\n',
  paste(cards, collapse = "\n"),
  "\n</div>\n"
)

knitr::asis_output(output)
```
